title: Score-Based Ideal Observer Approximation via Denoising Score Matching for Signal-Known-Exactly Detection Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.24768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Bayesian Ideal Observer (IO) establishes the theoretical upper bound on task performance for binary detection tasks. However, analytical computation of the IO test statistic is generally intractable. Numerical approaches based on Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, including their recent deep generative model-based extensions, typically require extensive posterior sampling for each test image. Supervised learning has also been investigated to approximate the IO performance. However, such methods are typically trained for a specific detection task and signal and may require retraining when the task or signal changes. The score function, defined as the gradient of the log probability density, encodes the local geometry of the data distribution and is a fundamental quantity in modern score-based generative modeling. translated_title: 基于去噪分数匹配的分数理想观测器近似用于信号已知精确检测任务
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯理想观测器（IO）为二元检测任务建立了任务性能的理论上限。然而，IO检验统计量的解析计算通常难以处理。基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法的数值方法，包括其最近的深度生成模型扩展，通常需要对每个测试图像进行大量的后验采样。监督学习也被研究用于近似IO性能。然而，这类方法通常针对特定检测任务和信号进行训练，当任务或信号变化时可能需要重新训练。分数函数定义为对数概率密度的梯度，编码了数据分布的局部几何结构，是现代基于分数的生成建模中的基本量。本工作将IO检验统计量重新表述为分数函数的形式，并引入了一种基于分数的理想观测器近似方法。
tldr: 该论文通过去噪分数匹配将理想观测器的检验统计量重新表示为分数函数形式，提出了一种无需重新训练即可适应不同检测任务和信号的分数理想观测器近似方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates the ideal observer test statistic in terms of the score function via denoising score matching, proposing a score-based ideal observer approximation that adapts to varying detection tasks and signals without retraining.
